e.title: insurance-experience
e.summary: 贝叶斯经验费率（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：保单级后验经验费率，个体风险调整
e.summary_en: Bayesian experience rating (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.1): policy-level posterior experience rating, individual risk adjustment
e.summary_hk: 貝葉斯經驗費率（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.1）：保單級後驗經驗費率，個體風險調整
e.body: insurance-experience（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做保单级的贝叶斯经验费率：个体索赔历史的后验更新——有索赔历史客户的费率按贝叶斯公式更新（经验费率）。对 RIAA：经验费率是车险等险种的核心机制（NCD/无索赔折扣的贝叶斯解释）——[[insurance-credibility]]（可信度理论）的保单级实现；后验更新给出「历史索赔该多大程度影响费率」的严谨答案；与 [[insurance-changepoint]]（风险变化检测）配套；理解贝叶斯经验费率 = 理解 NCD 系统的数学本质。
e.body_en: insurance-experience (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.1) does policy-level Bayesian experience rating: posterior updating from individual claim history — rates for customers with claim history are updated by Bayes' rule (experience rating). For RIAA: experience rating is a core mechanism in motor and other lines (the Bayesian interpretation of NCD/no-claims discount) — the policy-level implementation of [[insurance-credibility]]; posterior updating gives a rigorous answer to 'how much should claim history affect the rate'; pairs with [[insurance-changepoint]] (risk-change detection); understanding Bayesian experience rating = understanding the mathematical essence of NCD systems.
e.body_hk: insurance-experience（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.1）做保單級的貝葉斯經驗費率：個體索賠歷史的後驗更新——有索賠歷史客戶的費率按貝葉斯公式更新（經驗費率）。對 RIAA：經驗費率是車險等險種的核心機制（NCD/無索賠折扣的貝葉斯解釋）——[[insurance-credibility]]（可信度理論）的保單級實現；後驗更新給出「歷史索賠該多大程度影響費率」的嚴謹答案；與 [[insurance-changepoint]]（風險變化檢測）配套；理解貝葉斯經驗費率 = 理解 NCD 系統的數學本質。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.1 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
